---
title: "Crispy Buffalo Wings"
---

## Summary

Oven-baked chicken wings with crisp skin, a buttery hot sauce, roasted wedges, blue cheese dip, and crunchy raw vegetables for a full sharing-style meal.

- **Prep time:** 25 minutes
- **Cook time:** 1 hour 10 minutes
- **Serves:** 3 to 4

## Ingredients

### Wings

- [ ] 1 kg chicken wings
- [ ] 2.5 teaspoons baking powder
- [ ] 1/4 teaspoon plus 1/8 teaspoon fine salt
- [ ] Neutral oil spray or a little oil for the rack

### Wedges

- [ ] 500 g potatoes, cut into wedges
- [ ] 15 ml olive oil
- [ ] 1/2 teaspoon [Halen Mon Pure Sea Salt with Organic Spices](https://www.halenmon.com/products/pure-sea-salt-with-organic-spices)

### Buffalo sauce

- [ ] 60 g unsalted butter, melted
- [ ] 120 ml hot sauce
- [ ] 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- [ ] 1/4 teaspoon salt

### Blue cheese dip

- [ ] 75 g blue cheese, crumbled
- [ ] 120 ml sour cream
- [ ] 60 ml mayonnaise
- [ ] 1 small garlic clove, minced
- [ ] 1 to 3 tablespoons milk
- [ ] 2 tablespoon lemon juice
- [ ] Black pepper

### To serve

- [ ] 3 celery stalks, cut into sticks
- [ ] 2 carrots, cut into sticks
- [ ] Beer, optional

## Method

- [ ] Pat the wings very dry with kitchen paper.
- [ ] Heat the oven to 120°C. Line a tray with foil, place a rack on top, and lightly oil the rack.
- [ ] Toss the wings with baking powder and salt until evenly coated. Arrange them skin-side up on the rack in a single layer.
- [ ] Bake on a lower shelf for 30 minutes to start rendering the fat.
- [ ] Bring a pot of salted water to the boil, add the wedges, and parboil for 8 minutes. Drain well and let them steam-dry for 1 to 2 minutes.
- [ ] Raise the oven to 220°C, move the wings to an upper shelf, and bake for 40 minutes more until deep golden and crisp. Rotate the tray halfway through.
- [ ] After the wings have cooked at 220°C for 10 minutes, toss the parboiled wedges with olive oil and the Halen Mon spiced sea salt, spread on a tray, and roast on a lower shelf for the final 30 minutes.
- [ ] While the wings and wedges cook, whisk the melted butter, hot sauce, brown sugar, and salt until smooth.
- [ ] For the dip, mash the blue cheese into the sour cream, then stir in the mayonnaise, garlic, lemon juice, a splash of milk, and black pepper. Add more milk if you want a looser dip.
- [ ] Cut the celery and carrots into sticks so the cool, crisp vegetables are ready to serve alongside the hot wings and wedges.
- [ ] Toss the hot wings with the buffalo sauce just before serving, or serve the sauce on the side if you want the skin to stay as crisp as possible.
- [ ] Pile the wings onto a platter with the wedges, blue cheese dip, celery, and carrots, and serve straight away.

## Serving note

Serve as a relaxed sharing meal with the wedges, blue cheese dip, and vegetable sticks on the side. Use baking powder rather than baking soda, otherwise the coating will taste harsh.
